Total body mass (g) by species, after cleaning: Adelie 90,500 g; Chinstrap 22,475 g; Gentoo 105,800 g (52 rows used).

Data problems found and fixed:
- 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 6 and 16) were removed so body mass wouldn't be double-counted.
- body_mass_g was stored as text with 3 comma-formatted values (e.g. '3,300'); the column was cast to numeric with no values lost.
- body_mass_g was verified against the rules range [2500, 6500] — all values in range.
- species labels were verified against the allowed set (Adelie, Chinstrap, Gentoo) — no variants or misspellings.

Not fixed (not needed for this question): island has label variants ('Dream ', 'Torgerson', 'Bisco') and sex has a case variant ('FEMALE'); these columns weren't used in the analysis.
